sql.aurora.getIdByProjectProcessStepId: select ppscfv.text_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.id = ppscfv.project_process_step_id where ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = :cfgaId and ppscfv.project_process_step_id = :ppsId and pps.main is true
